ignore.reason: nanoid@3.3.17 (CVE-2026-67213) is a build-time-only transitive dependency of postcss, used for source-map ID generation during `vite build`. The advisory requires calling customAlphabet/customRandom with size <= 0, which postcss never does and which is not reachable from runtime code or user input in this app. Accepted temporarily; permanent fix is pinning nanoid ^3.3.18 in overrides + regenerating bun.lock on the next dependency-update PR.
